_meta.description: Pilot dataset for SITWE 2026 — 20 NL/SQL pairs over concert_singer with EvoSchema-style perturbations.
_meta.evoschema_alignment: Subset of EvoSchema (Zhang et al., 2025) table-level + column-level operators.

queries.question: How many singers do we have?
queries.gold_pre: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer
queries.gold_post: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artist

queries.question: What is the name and country of every singer?
queries.gold_pre: SELECT Name, Country FROM singer
queries.gold_post: SELECT Name, Country FROM artist

queries.question: List the names of singers from France.
queries.gold_pre: SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE Country = 'France'
queries.gold_post: SELECT Name FROM artist WHERE Country = 'France'

queries.question: What are the names of all singers ordered by age from oldest to youngest?
queries.gold_pre: SELECT Name FROM singer ORDER BY Age DESC
queries.gold_post: SELECT Name FROM artist ORDER BY Age DESC

queries.question: How many male singers are there?
queries.gold_pre: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer WHERE Is_male = 'T'
queries.gold_post: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artist WHERE Is_male = 'T'

queries.question: What is the average, minimum, and maximum age of all singers?
queries.gold_pre: SELECT AVG(Age), MIN(Age), MAX(Age) FROM singer
queries.gold_post: SELECT AVG(Age), MIN(Age), MAX(Age) FROM artist

queries.question: List each country and the number of singers from that country.
queries.gold_pre: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) FROM singer GROUP BY Country
queries.gold_post: SELECT Country, COUNT(*) FROM artist GROUP BY Country

queries.question: Show the name of the oldest singer.
queries.gold_pre: SELECT Name FROM singer ORDER BY Age DESC LIMIT 1
queries.gold_post: SELECT Name FROM artist ORDER BY Age DESC LIMIT 1

queries.question: Show the names of all singers and the names of concerts they performed in.
queries.gold_pre: SELECT T2.Name, T3.concert_Name FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN singer AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID = T2.Singer_ID JOIN concert AS T3 ON T1.Concert_ID = T3.Concert_ID
queries.gold_post: SELECT T2.Name, T3.concert_Name FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN artist AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID = T2.Singer_ID JOIN concert AS T3 ON T1.Concert_ID = T3.Concert_ID

queries.question: List the names of singers who performed in a concert with theme 'Wide Awake'.
queries.gold_pre: SELECT T2.Name FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN singer AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID = T2.Singer_ID JOIN concert AS T3 ON T1.Concert_ID = T3.Concert_ID WHERE T3.Theme = 'Wide Awake'
queries.gold_post: SELECT T2.Name FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN artist AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID = T2.Singer_ID JOIN concert AS T3 ON T1.Concert_ID = T3.Concert_ID WHERE T3.Theme = 'Wide Awake'

queries.question: Count how many singers performed in each concert.
queries.gold_pre: SELECT T2.concert_Name, COUNT(*) FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN concert AS T2 ON T1.Concert_ID = T2.Concert_ID GROUP BY T2.concert_Name
queries.gold_post: SELECT T2.concert_Name, COUNT(*) FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN concert AS T2 ON T1.Concert_ID = T2.Concert_ID GROUP BY T2.concert_Name

queries.question: Show the names of singers who did not perform in any concert.
queries.gold_pre: SELECT Name FROM singer WHERE Singer_ID NOT IN (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert)
queries.gold_post: SELECT Name FROM artist WHERE Singer_ID NOT IN (SELECT Singer_ID FROM singer_in_concert)

queries.question: Show each singer's name and their song name.
queries.gold_pre: SELECT Name, Song_Name FROM singer
queries.gold_post: SELECT Name, song_title FROM artist

queries.question: List the song name of each singer ordered by release year ascending.
queries.gold_pre: SELECT Song_Name FROM singer ORDER BY Song_release_year ASC
queries.gold_post: SELECT song_title FROM artist ORDER BY debut_year ASC

queries.question: What is the song name of the youngest singer?
queries.gold_pre: SELECT Song_Name FROM singer ORDER BY Age ASC LIMIT 1
queries.gold_post: SELECT song_title FROM artist ORDER BY Age ASC LIMIT 1

queries.question: Count songs released after 2010.
queries.gold_pre: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM singer WHERE Song_release_year > 2010
queries.gold_post: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM artist WHERE debut_year > 2010

queries.question: Show the song name and release year of every French singer.
queries.gold_pre: SELECT Song_Name, Song_release_year FROM singer WHERE Country = 'France'
queries.gold_post: SELECT song_title, debut_year FROM artist WHERE Country = 'France'

queries.question: Show the average song release year per country.
queries.gold_pre: SELECT Country, AVG(Song_release_year) FROM singer GROUP BY Country
queries.gold_post: SELECT Country, AVG(debut_year) FROM artist GROUP BY Country

queries.question: Show the song name of every singer who performed in the 'Auditions' concert.
queries.gold_pre: SELECT T2.Song_Name FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN singer AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID = T2.Singer_ID JOIN concert AS T3 ON T1.Concert_ID = T3.Concert_ID WHERE T3.concert_Name = 'Auditions'
queries.gold_post: SELECT T2.song_title FROM singer_in_concert AS T1 JOIN artist AS T2 ON T1.Singer_ID = T2.Singer_ID JOIN concert AS T3 ON T1.Concert_ID = T3.Concert_ID WHERE T3.concert_Name = 'Auditions'

queries.question: Find the stadium with the largest capacity.
queries.gold_pre: SELECT Name FROM stadium ORDER BY Capacity DESC LIMIT 1
queries.gold_post: SELECT Name FROM stadium ORDER BY Capacity DESC LIMIT 1
